summary: Learn customer feature design, propensity modelling and campaign evaluation with Python and scikit-learn. Explore the course and build practical analytics skill
lede: Customer growth analytics applies machine learning to customer data to guide acquisition, retention and expansion decisions. It is for marketing analysts, customer insight specialists and data professionals who need to turn predictions into campaign priorities. Learners prepare customer features with Python and pandas, fit propensity models with scikit-learn, evaluate precision, recall and calibration, and shape contact rules and monitoring scorecards; uplift testing and production deployment receive guided or operational coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use customer records to prioritize growth actions and need a defensible route from prediction to campaign decision. It suits intermediate learners with relevant analytics experience.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic statistics and customer or marketing data is expected. Python coding is required for the hands-on exercises; prior familiarity with Python notebooks and tabular data is recommended.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
